{{Top}}
A '''heuristic combat programming''' was a program that helped users in their training. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]'s [[Brain/Legends|brain]] was [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implanted with one to assist in his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to allow him to fight [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="ROTSTVD">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]</ref>
